Tarnovell Bioscience Group
November 2025
People Operations, Nottingham

slides.title: How to read this chart
bullets: The chart shows reporting lines for head office and for the six integrated firms, A to F
Scientific leadership at each firm reports to its own site head, who then reports to group
Shared services (finance, HR, quality, commercial and IT) report to the group function owner
Names are shown only for head office roles; site heads are listed on the firm pages of the intranet
slides.notes: Where a box says local, the post holder is recorded in the firm's own staff list and in the HR system.

slides.title: Shared administration and retained science
bullets: Shared administration is coordinated by the relevant group function owners; IT and SharePoint migration remain in progress, with local shares preserved as archive roots
Scientific operations, study direction and client contact stay with each firm and its site head
Local accession numbers, notebooks and filing practices are unchanged for every firm
Group quality oversight is by audit and review, not by taking over local quality systems

slides.title: Directory and ownership controls
bullets: A-F directory entries are consolidated; retained scientific roles remain within each site
Directory consolidation does not itself establish completion of archive or systems migration
Leaver folders require ownership checks before migration acceptance
Please raise any error on your firm branch with People Operations by the end of November
